Description: Genuine brown leather and men's medium

Large cream-colored canvas tote bag with navy-blue shoulder straps and a small embroidered university logo near the bottom corner. The bag contains a spiral notebook with handwritten class notes, a reusable stainless-steel coffee cup, several pens, and a black zippered pouch. It was found resting underneath a table near a study area.

Dark green insulated winter coat with a hood trimmed in faux fur, two large front pockets with snap closures, and a silver zipper that runs down the center. A pair of knit gloves was found inside the left pocket. The coat appears lightly worn and has no visible personal identification on the outside.

Medium-sized black backpack with padded shoulder straps, a front organizer pocket, two mesh side pockets, and a reflective strip across the lower front panel. Inside are several empty folders, a charging cable, a calculator, and a notebook with no clearly visible owner name. The bag was left near a seating area.
